title: 小学四年级
description: 适合9-10岁孩子，章节书阅读能力萌芽、科普纪录片式短片、幽默故事理解
descriptionEn: For children aged 9-10. Sprouting chapter book reading ability, documentary-style science shorts, humor story comprehension.

items.description: 调皮男孩Henry的搞笑日常，英式幽默+长对话，适合从绘本向章节书过渡的孩子。
items.descriptionEn: Funny daily life of naughty boy Henry. British humor plus long dialogues, great for kids transitioning from picture books to chapter books.

items.description: 改编自伊妮德·布莱顿经典儿童文学，奇幻冒险故事，词汇量明显提升。
items.descriptionEn: Adapted from Enid Blyton's classic children's literature. Fantasy adventure stories with noticeably expanded vocabulary.

items.description: 戴冒鼠和助手Penfold的特工冒险，英式冷幽默+双关语，适合英语基础较好的孩子。
items.descriptionEn: Secret agent Danger Mouse and assistant Penfold on adventures. British dry humor plus puns, for kids with stronger English foundation.

items.description: 三只小怪兽用数学解决镇上的问题，数学概念用英语讲解，学科英语好素材。
items.descriptionEn: Three little monsters solve town problems using math. Math concepts explained in English, great subject-English material.

items.description: 女孩主导的STEM项目短片，科学实验+工程挑战，鼓励女孩参与科学。
items.descriptionEn: Girl-led STEM project shorts. Science experiments plus engineering challenges, encouraging girls in science.

items.description: 五个好奇的StoryBots回答孩子提出的问题（为什么天是蓝的？），科普知识+洗脑歌曲。
items.descriptionEn: Five curious StoryBots answer kids' questions (Why is the sky blue?). Science facts plus catchy songs.

items.description: 双胞胎医生兄弟用实验和医院实拍讲解人体知识，医学词汇丰富但讲解有趣不吓人。
items.descriptionEn: Twin doctor brothers explain human body knowledge through experiments and hospital footage. Rich medical vocabulary, fun and not scary.

items.description: Steve Backshall寻找全球最致命的动物，野生动物纪录片风格，高阶科普英语。
items.descriptionEn: Steve Backshall hunts for the world's deadliest animals. Wildlife documentary style, advanced science English.

items.description: BBC最长寿的儿童节目，手工制作、挑战任务、动物嘉宾应有尽有，地道英式英语。
items.descriptionEn: BBC's longest-running children's show. Crafts, challenge tasks, animal guests. Authentic British English.
